title: Deen - Islamic App
meta_description: Prayer-Time, Prayer Tracker, Al-Quran, Al-Hadith, Qibla, Dua, Tasbih, Education
full_description: Deen App is an Islamic App which covers everything that a Muslim need in one place. The app gives you the actual prayer time of all places around the world keeping daily and monthly track of your prayers and notifies you 5 times a day so that you don’t miss out any prayer. The app can be used in both Bangla and English language.However, as we mentioned earlier, Deen App covers everything that a Muslim need. Below the description of every modules are given-Prayer Time Features:•	Everyday 5 prayer waqt time according to the user’s location•	Sunset and Sunrise time is also shown in the module•	Start time and End time of prayers is shown on the home screen•	Everyday Sehri and Iftar time is shown on the home screenAl-Quran Features:•	The module is divided into 3 parts: Surah, Juz and Quran•	Read all Surahs in Arabic with English and Bangla meaning •	Audio recitation of all Surahs•	Read Quran by Juz in Arabic with English and Bangla meaning •	Read Quran Sharif from any page and zoom in, zoom out according to your preferenceQibla Features•	You can search for Qibla direction from anywhere and fastHadith Features•	Read Hadith both in Bangla and English•	Share or Save any Hadith to anywhere•	Daily motivational hadith on home screen**Bangla Hadith source - Sahih al-Bukhari (Tawhid Publication).Tasbih Features•	Use the Tasbih, if you do not have any tasbih in your hand. •	count your dhikr wherever you are.•	Keep notes of the dhikr you are doing.Duas Features•	Read Duas in Arabic with Bangla and English meaning•	Read Duas with Bangla pronunciation •	You can find sources with every Duas with themCommunity •	Read posts of others regarding Islam•	Post if you have anything to share or have any question•	Communicate with other Muslim brothers and sistersNearest Mosque featuresFind your nearest mosque on Map in a moment from wherever you are.Asma Ul HusnaKnow the 99 names of Allah Know the virtue of each name of Allah with meaning.Deen EducationKalima – read the 6 kalima in Arabic with both English and Bangla pronunciation and meaning.Library – it contains various books of Islam with life stories of our Prophets and many more.Nurani Quran – learn to read Quran easily on your phone.Ayatul Kursi – learn Ayatul Kursi in Arabic with English and Bangla pronunciation(with Audio) and meaning.***This feature is updated with new educational stuff (Ablution, Prayer, etc.) to make your life with Islam easier.NOTES: Keep updating the app to get the features we are bringing up next to help your day pass with Islam smoothly. We hope, this app will make your mindset stronger and focused on your prayers every day. If any person gets any wrong information anywhere or any bug anywhere, please give us an email at ‘admin@coderflies.com‘, Insha’Allah we will fix the issue as soon as possible.We hope the grace of Allah follows you every day and everywhere. May Allah bless you and make you a righteous person. Ameen
